name: identity
command: getprop ro.product.model; getprop ro.product.device; getprop ro.twrp.version; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; uname -a; cat /sys/class/power_supply/battery/capacity

name: partition-hashes
command: for n in boot vendor_boot init_boot dtbo vbmeta; do blockdev --getsize64 /dev/block/by-name/$n; sha256sum /dev/block/by-name/$n; done
